surveyed.source: OSM node 440673918 (Simon Carmiggelt, bust by Kees Verkade, 1988); bust read from Anefo photographs 934-3460..3464 (Rob Croes, CC0, 1988-10-25); the 2020 panoramas show only a blurred pillar; facing (150 degrees, +-45) and the pillar and bust sizes are estimates. The brief placed it on the Kloveniersburgwal; OSM and the 1988 photographs put it in the Weteringplantsoen

attribution.title: Simon Carmiggelt bust (Weteringplantsoen) - reconstruction from photographs
attribution.author: Map Recall; sculpture by Kees Verkade (1988); figure reconstructed from photographs by Ceescamel, Rob Croes / Anefo
attribution.modifications: Figure reconstructed (TRELLIS.2 multi-view) from Wikimedia Commons photographs: "Simon Carmiggeltbeeld.jpg" by Ceescamel (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Simon_Carmiggeltbeeld.jpg); "Borstbeeld Simon Carmiggelt (Kronkel) onthuld in Amsterdamweduwe Tiny Carmigge…, Bestanddeelnr 934-3460.jpg" by Rob Croes / Anefo (CC0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Borstbeeld_Simon_Carmiggelt_(Kronkel)_onthuld_in_Amsterdamweduwe_Tiny_Carmigge%E2%80%A6,_Bestanddeelnr_934-3460.jpg); "Borstbeeld Simon Carmiggelt (Kronkel) onthuld in Amsterdam Ton van Duinhoven en, Bestanddeelnr 934-3461.jpg" by Rob Croes / Anefo (CC0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Borstbeeld_Simon_Carmiggelt_(Kronkel)_onthuld_in_Amsterdam_Ton_van_Duinhoven_en,_Bestanddeelnr_934-3461.jpg). Decimated to about 6,000 triangles per figure in the kit's material, no photo colour; plinth, pier and setting are the original low-poly kit model.
